news.title: Mother, 2-year-old daughter found dead by Cobb County church
news.summary: A young mother and her 2-year-old daughter were found shot to death inside a vehicle parked outside a church on Sunday morning, Cobb County police said.

news.title: Woman charged with felony murder after fatal fentanyl overdose
news.summary: A 48-year-old woman has been charged with felony murder following an investigation into a fatal overdose in Lawrenceville, according to Gwinnett County police.

news.title: Woman arrested in Coweta after stealing U.S. Postal Service van
news.summary: A woman is facing state and federal charges after allegedly stealing an unoccupied U.S. Postal Service mail truck in Columbus and driving it 80 miles to metro Atlanta before being caught.

news.title: Metro Atlanta man arrested, accused of running over estranged wife and leaving her to die
news.summary: Janice Frazier, 58, was killed earlier this year when she was run over. Police have now charged her husband.

news.title: Newnan businessman sentenced to 15 years in $76M Ponzi scheme
news.summary: A 69-year-old Newnan man will spend 15 years in federal prison after defrauding more than 300 investors out of $76 million in a massive Ponzi scheme, according to federal prosecutors.

news.title: Clark Atlanta students demand intersection changes after fatal crash
news.summary: Students at Clark Atlanta University are mobilizing to demand safety upgrades at a dangerous city intersection following the death of a classmate.

news.summary: The Coweta Judicial Circuit District Attorney's Office disclosed new evidence Monday regarding the police shooting of 18-year-old Zadarious Dorsey.

news.title: Fatal overdose leads to felony murder charge for Gwinnett woman
news.summary: A 48-year-old woman is facing a felony murder charge after Gwinnett County police connected her to a fatal fentanyl overdose in Lawrenceville earlier this month, according to authorities.
